In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] formed a criminal [[organization]] called the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] and he wished to '''secure a partnership''' with the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], in addition to his [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] allies.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Our combined strength ''will'' be rewarded, Mandalore will be yours—and Kenobi, this Sith pretender Dooku, and ''all'' our enemies will fall.|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to Pre Vizsla|<ref name="Eminence" />}}
While traveling through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], members of the radical [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter-faction known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] came across a derelict [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] drifting above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Upon [[Docking tube/Legends|boarding]] the craft, Death Watch discovered the unconscious bodies of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]; at the word of the group's leader, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the two [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]] were brought aboard one of Death Watch's [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class fighters]]—Vizsla's personal [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], [[Gauntlet (Pre Vizsla)/Legends|''Gauntlet'']]—and taken back to the Death Watch's [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|encampment]]<ref name="SC" /> on the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]-covered [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]].<ref name="Zanbar">{{SWE|locations|zanbar|Zanbar}}</ref> There, Death Watch attended to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] injuries before Vizsla invited Darth Maul to talk, during which the two found they had a mutual enemy in the form of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] equally despised by both [[Gender/Legends|men]]. Upon that shared animosity, Maul and Vizsla founded an alliance in pursuit of mutual benefit: the Sith would aid Death Watch in deposing [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], while Death Watch would assist the Sith in their plans to punish Kenobi for his [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|actions]] against Maul a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior.<ref name="SC" />

Together, Death Watch and the Sith set out to assemble an [[Army/Legends|army]] of followers, beginning their search at a [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|fortress]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] belonging to the leaders of a branch of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Negotiations with the syndicate branch's [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] leaders were quick to sour, leading Savage Opress to [[Sai cha/Legends|kill]] them while Maul recruited the organization's [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]], [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], who authorized an alliance in the fallen leaders' stead. Back on Zanbar, with freshly gained supplies and a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|Black Sun foot soldiers]] in tow, Pre Vizsla and Maul were approached by [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]], leader of a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-dealing [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]].<ref name="SC" /> Having caught word of Maul's intentions to raise a force of criminals, the [[Pyke/Legends|Pykes]] moved to willingly join the growing assembly, and were readily welcomed by Death Watch and the Sith. With their newest allies, Death Watch set out for [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with a small attack force was comprised of three [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport/Legends|''Kom'rk''-class starfighters]] loaded with squads of Death Watch foot soldiers and three [[Sarisa-class gunship/Legends|''Sarisa''-class gunships]] headed toward Nal Hutta and landed at the [[Hutt Council Chamber/Legends|Hutt Council Chamber]].

==The mission==
{{Quote|There are many things the Hutts influence and possess that would prove useful to us.|Darth Maul appeals to the Hutt Grand Council|<ref name="SC" />}}
[[File:BountyHunterTableDance-Eminence.png|thumb|left|250px|Hired bounty hungers leap to the defense of their employers]]
On [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], Maul attempted to appeal to the Hutt Grand Council, through [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]], [[Arok/Legends|Arok]] and [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]]. Jabba stated that he would ally with him if he was presented with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but Maul said he had none. Oruba asked if they had anything to trade, and Maul stated it was their lives for [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and all they possessed.

Jabba then summoned his bounty hunters to face the three, and he had one of his [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]], hurl a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] at Maul's head. Before it could reach its target, Opress [[Telekinesis/Legends|halted it]] and the knife went hurling back to the feet of the [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]], [[Marrok (anooba)/Legends|Marrok]]. Jabba then had his bounty hunters eliminate the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lords and [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Vizsla]]. The two Sith deflected shots as some [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] guards ran to the Hutts' aid from a side door. Savage cut one down, and threw two more at the bounty hunters. Vizla shot the last two Nikto guards, then used a [[flamethrower]] to help cover their retreat. By the time the [[Fire/Legends|flames had fanned]], the Sith and Vizsla had a head start on their escape.

Soon after the retreat, they made their way to a landing platform where [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] and the rest of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] lay in wait for them. After making known their presence by firing rockets into the Hutt guards' lines, they chased the surviving ones back into the palace, while the leaders followed, much slower, behind. After all of the [[Death Watch]] members were away chasing after the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] guards, Sugi leapt from the ceiling and managed to knock down Maul. Before he could move in, she kicked Vizsla away. Maul used his [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to slash at Sugi, only for her to roll away from each strike. He was soon attacked by the anooba, [[Marrok (anooba)/Legends|Marrok]], and was forced to the ground. He managed to ward it off him, and then flew Sugi across the room. Opress briefly skirmished with [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], showing a display of unarmed combat. Eventually, Opress punched Embo's hat, which sent him hurling across the room.

Vizsla, meanwhile, recovered from Sugi's kick and pulled out used his [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]] at the sight of retreating Nikto guards. With the Darksaber, he cut a swath through them all. Their attempts at escape failed, and they all perished. Smoke pellets then disorientated the three, as the bounty hunters fled. Maul stated simply to leave them as bounty hunters like them had no affiliations with anyone.

==Aftermath==
{{Dialogue|Oruba|Tatooine! Tatooine!|Vizsla|Jabba's palace.|Maul|So the only thing that you can tell me is that I will find Jabba... at Jabba's palace?|attr=Maul and Vizsla ask Oruba about the location of the Hutts, before killing the Hutt|src=<ref name="Eminence" />}}
[[File:OrubasDeath-Eminence.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]] before his death.]]

Almost all the Nikto guards were killed. Though the mission ended as a failure, [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]] was captured by Bo-Katan and her soldiers. Oruba stated he knew not of where his allies were hiding. Maul then ordered for Opress to kill him as the elder Hutt proved useless to them, but Oruba stated that his allies were holed up in Jabba's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the Outer Rim world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Still, Maul had Opress kill Oruba. They then [[Attack on Jabba's Palace/Legends|set course for Tatooine]].
